CSV files you export are saved wherever you choose. BeStrong only reads the CSV files you select to import.
Uninstalling the app or clearing its data from Android Settings removes all BeStrong information from the device.

If you turn on export, BeStrong writes each finished workout to Health Connect as a weightlifting or cardio session (start, end, name and notes), its total and active calories (measured by the watch, or calculated from your heart rate or duration and body weight if you train without the watch), the heart-rate graph measured by the watch and the distance covered running, walking, on the treadmill or cycling. If you allow it, it also reads your weight, height, sleep and resting heart rate to calculate daily readiness and your energy expenditure, and the heart rate recorded by other devices during your workouts to estimate their intensity. You can revoke the permissions at any time in Settings › Health Connect. It also writes each set as a segment of the session (exercise type and repetitions) and the body weight and body-fat % you log in Measurements.

Exercise animations and images are downloaded from exercisedb.dev (AscendAPI) and wger.de. No personal data is sent with those downloads. Your technique photos and videos are stored only in the app’s private storage.
All your data (workouts, routines, measurements and settings) is stored only on your phone and watch. BeStrong has no servers, creates no accounts and shares no data with third parties.

The watch measures your heart rate and calories with Health Services only while a workout is in progress. Data travels between phone and watch over the Wear OS Bluetooth/Wi-Fi connection and never leaves your devices.
